structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a pump.fun coin launched through UsePaid, set up so trading fees go to Crémieux (@cremieuxrecueil), with a link to one of his tweets. It sits inside a burst of "Cream" coins. The largest of them, a different contract (CMuv…), is at $583k market cap with $508k of volume in the last hour. This coin spiked to about $537k within minutes of launch, crashed about 80%, and is now bouncing around $110k.

narrative.description: A wave of Cream memecoins tied to Crémieux (@cremieuxrecueil), a large X account that is apparently commenting on the coin in a mocking or ambivalent way.
narrative.why_spreading: A big account is reacting to a memecoin about himself, and UsePaid fee-sharing gives the coin a "fees go to the celebrity" angle.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the UsePaid version that routes fees to Crémieux, which could give it a claim to being "official" if he claims the fees or endorses it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CMuvWQ6q… Cream: $583k market cap, $81k liquidity, $508k volume in the last hour, created about 3h earlier and clearly dominant. CZMCS3… Cream: $52k market cap. Many dead Cream clones.

authenticity.evidence: Search snippets say Crémieux posted that any proceeds should go to eliminating pit bulls and that he doesn't understand the scam (https://x.com/cremieuxrecueil/status/2103645390620741643). That is ambivalent, and it does not identify this contract. On-chain there are about 1.9k unique buyers and sellers.
